limits: No native observer-history run or full-shipping transaction was executed as part of this review.
The measure is a reference-area quadrature capacity-loss proxy; it does not report actual geometric opening, debond area, or physical qualification.

mechanical_review.analyzer: requires quadrature-specific status; old face-maximum status is rejected as inconclusive_legacy_face_maximum_not_quadrature_area
mechanical_review.failed_cell_rule: point damage exactly 1.0 counts one equal reference-area quadrature cell; no tolerance is added
mechanical_review.force_quadrature: each of the three quadrature forces uses face.geometry.w / 3.0f
mechanical_review.invalid_input: nonfinite/out-of-range history or nonpositive/nonfinite reference area fails closed
mechanical_review.native_face_state_x: maximum of the three point damage values in the mixed cohesive kernel (maximumDamage=max(nextHistory.w), stored in next.state.x)
mechanical_review.probe_input: the accepted snapshot’s three mixedPointHistory[].w values, not face.state.x
mechanical_review.reported_quantity: reference cohesive area with zero tensile/shear traction capacity, explicitly not geometric opening/debond area
mechanical_review.whole_face_rule: all three quadrature point damages must equal 1.0

scope: Source205 cohesive quadrature failed-capacity-area observer and analyzer; no solver or physical qualification.
